result.subject: Welcome to our London office – Monday 30 November
result.body:
Dear Dutch retail bank team,

We look forward to welcoming you on Monday 30 November at 14:30 for a QBR.

Our office is located at 3rd Floor, 21 Copper Row, London EC2A 4LT.

Please proceed to the ground‑floor reception, present photo ID to collect building passes and follow the signs to the Boardroom. The nearest stations are Liverpool Street (6 min walk) and Moorgate (8 min). Guest Wi‑Fi details will be displayed on the welcome screen in the meeting room.

Your host, the Chief Revenue Officer, will meet you in the Boardroom.

Agenda:
- Welcome and introductions
- Quarter in review: service performance
- Roadmap update
- Priorities for next quarter

Kind regards,
Business Operations
